# event aspect

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventAspect`](gmeow-eventAspect.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventAspect>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The grammatical aspect of a textual mention of the event (ISO-TimeML EVENT @aspect). Annotation-layer only; orthogonal to the event's actual temporal placement.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`gmeow:GrammaticalAspect`](../classes/gmeow-GrammaticalAspect.md)

Use [`gmeow:eventAspect`](gmeow-eventAspect.md) from [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) to [`gmeow:GrammaticalAspect`](../classes/gmeow-GrammaticalAspect.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md), [`gmeow:GrammaticalAspect`](../classes/gmeow-GrammaticalAspect.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the grammatical aspect of a textual mention of an event (ISO-TimeML EVENT @aspect) when annotating natural-language text.

### Avoid when

- Avoid inferring it from, or using it to infer, the event's actual temporal placement — aspect is a linguistic-realization facet, orthogonal to dating.

### How to use

- Point the [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) at one [`gmeow:GrammaticalAspect`](../classes/gmeow-GrammaticalAspect.md) value via [`gmeow:eventAspect`](gmeow-eventAspect.md); keep it confined to the annotation layer.
